name: Buck Euchre
summary: Cut-throat solo Euchre where each player must avoid winning zero tricks and race to zero points.
rules_text: 24 cards: A K Q J 10 9 in each suit. Each player gets 5 cards, one card turned up as proposed trump. Right bower is high trump, left bower is second high. If turned card is clubs, clubs are trump automatically and all must play. Otherwise bidding: in order, players may order up turned suit; dealer may take it or turn it down; if turned down, players may name another trump. The trump maker must take at least 3 tricks. Others in turn choose to stay in or drop out; stayers must take at least 1 trick. No-trump hand occurs if no trump named and all must play. Trick play: must follow suit, left bower counts as trump. Highest trump or highest of suit led wins trick. Scoring from 25 points: subtract 1 per trick won. Maker who fails to make 3 adds 5 instead of subtracting. Stayer who takes 0 tricks adds 5. Dropouts score 0. Taking all 5 tricks wins instantly, otherwise first to 0 or below wins, most negative breaks ties.
rating_reason: Individual Euchre variant with bidding and drop-out, hidden hands strategic
